title: Dominaria United Commander: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: He was born with the crescent-moon Mark of the Elder Druid, tying his fate to the druids of the Juniper Order.
"For their courage, the griffins were granted domain over all the desert skies." —Afari, *Tales*
"I hate the smell of charred Phyrexian, but it sure beats the alternative!" —Jaya
A thousand years ago, Phyrexia poisoned Serra's Realm and engineered its collapse. On shimmering waves generations in the making, the angels finally took their revenge.
Eons ago, the ur-dragon roared. Its descendants still carry the echo across the Multiverse.
Jhoira stumbled upon an ally, not just a good source of spare parts.
"We learned from the best. And the worst. Pretty much whoever was available."
Tobias spent decades tormenting pirates on the open sea and decades more dancing lifelessly beneath it.
He could be anyone, anywhere, but he'll never again be "half" of anything.
Driven by rage, directed by his emperor's claw.
"I've had my adventures. All I wish now is to sit in peace and speak with the pines."
"Why butcher an army when you can slash a single throat for the same result?"
Martyred for worshipping her ancestors, she now walks among them.
"If you wish to die as a hero, you must first live as one." —General Takeno
The best presents are impossible to regift.
When the established order falters, what remains are ordinary people and their struggle to survive.
"As my kha, he is the source of my inspiration. As my brother, he is the embodiment of my aspirations." —Ajani Goldmane
"The Ancestor saved us for a purpose."
Centuries ago, one man's vengeance plunged the world into ice and darkness.
The sky takes flight and the earth trembles.
A single lie unleashes a tide of disbelief.
"Conquering your first world is the hardest, after all. My power grew as I moved from world to world, taking anything that would make the next taking easier." —Ob Nixilis
"I will not live as a slave. If you would be free, then fight alongside me."
Odric resisted the vampire's curse with all his strength. But after a lifetime of fighting monsters, he was doomed to become one himself.
"I will be your most demanding master, Liliana. But I have great things in mind for you."
"I have seen things that would reduce a weaker person to blubbering and raving. Want to hear about them?" —Vraska
As the Eldrazi spread, no secret that could give Zendikar's defenders an advantage was considered too dangerous to seek.
The dead know lessons the living haven't learned.
"Greet death with sword in hand."
The storm rages and the earth breaks.
Aboard her ship, the *Dragon's Smile*, Kari follows no one's rules but her own.
"After the people flee, but before the enemy arrives—that's grabbin' time."
The fires of Zendikar are always hungry, and there is much on which they can feed.
"Right now, in these first moments of creation, it is simultaneously nothing and everything."
"Monsters dwell in every heart. We only think civilization tames them." ―Euphemia, Nexus watcher
All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.
An explorer's reward is a view of tomorrow's possibilities.
Torching Krosa would be pointless. It grows faster than it burns.
"How truly vast this city must be, that I have traveled so far and seen so much, yet never once found the place where the buildings fail."
"The land grows only where the kami will it." —Dosan the Falling Leaf
"Life ... is not ... a race."
"I won't abandon the *Weatherlight*. My destiny is to serve at Jhoira's side. This 'illness' means I must trust my faith more and myself less."
Its beak rends flesh and bone, exposing the tender marrow of dream.
"It's easy to get taken in by the spectacle, to enjoy a bit of naughty amusement. But make no mistake: the Cult of Rakdos is a danger." —Tajic
Snaking remnants of nature directed by a body of thought and progress, the oracles embody all that is Simic.
The Abzan turn to this spell only as a last resort, for its inevitable result is what they most dread: to be alone.
Its wide-reaching roots draw more than water.
As the shards merged into the Maelstrom, their mana energies fused into new monstrosities.
When it awoke, it shook the plane with the thunder of its craving.
Cyclical and spiral patterns are the specialty of the Gyre Clade, which seeks to revitalize the cycles of nature.
Teysa convened the meeting of the Obzedat. Kaya ended it.
"I embrace all of Alara, Grixis as much as Bant. Let my former home call me traitor. I do this not for accolades, but because it is right."
Alara's burning blood cannot be contained by mere earth and stone.
There is no world where angels fear to tread.
"Your debt is erased." —Hilgur, Orzhov euthanist
At his behest the Kami War began to regain That Which Was Taken.
Centuries ago, five dragons conquered death to rule the living.
"The Lowlands refuse to suffer at the whims of the High City."
"Strike," the fumes hiss. "Raise an empire with your ambition."
Both his rank and his scars were earned in single combat against a cave bear.
"I run the maze alone, but I fight with the full might of the Legion."
Like his mother before him, Darigaaz gave his life defending Dominaria from the tyranny of self-styled "gods."
"To comprehend the full answer requires years of temporal study. In short, they were now never born in the first place." —Teferi
It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.
It spilled the blood of one elder dragon. In Gideon's hands, it may yet taste another's.
"The worthy shall strive for greatness. Supremacy in life leads to supremacy in the afterlife." —Monument inscription
It harmonizes with the essence of its master.
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?" —Mairsil, the Pretender
"The worthy shall rush to the God-Pharaoh's side with relentless zeal, rising to overcome every obstacle." —Monument inscription
"You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned." "And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.
Before being presented to its lord, each shaku is blessed by every hero of every region within that lord's domain.
"The worthy shall respect the worthy. In the afterlife, all will stand united." —Monument inscription
"The explorer who found it got a bad deal when he sold it. He merely got rich."
Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.
One shard of Selenia yet remained.
Reluctant to meet face to face, the leaders of the ten guilds prefer to do official business through a go-between immune to bribes and threats.
"We must rely on our own knowledge, not on the dogma of the seekers or the mutterings of the sphinxes." —Tullus of Palandius
The continent of Murasa lies beneath a blanket of dense vegetation, its enormous branches tangled so thickly that some inhabitants never see the ground.
"The rushing water is as the God-Pharaoh. It encompasses all. It nurtures all." —Temmet, vizier of Naktamun
On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.
"Approach my tower on bended knee or depart from it as ash upon the wind." —Gadwick, the Wizened
It's said the spirits of the drowned dead hang their lights from the shattered figureheads.
"How tragic that greed eclipses beauty." —Seton, centaur druid
When the Planeswalker Angrath called dinosaurs "dragons," the name stuck in certain pirate circles.
Every world is an organism, able to grow new lands. Some just do it faster than others.
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them." —Pulan, Bant orchardist
"The most powerful dreams visit those who shelter in a dragon's skull." —Chianul, Who Whispers Twice
All are welcome.
On Naya, ambition and treachery are scarce, hunted nearly to extinction by the awe owed to terrestrial gods.
"Center of the Sea, Eye of the World, Shrine of Enlightenment. Seek it for answers. Seek it for healing. Seek it and return transformed." —Scroll fragment from the ruins of Minamo
Sometimes the strongest weapon you can hold in your hand is another hand.
When asked how many paths reach enlightenment, the monk kicked a heap of sand. "Count," he smiled, "and then find more grains."
"Only the weak imprison themselves behind walls. We live free under the wind, and our freedom makes us strong." —Zurgo, khan of the Mardu
The dense jungle surrenders to a lush and lavish expanse. At its center uncoil the spires of Qarsi Palace.
The continent of Ondu is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.
Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.
That which endures, survives.
Jund is a world as cruel as those who call it home. Their brutal struggles scar the land even as it carves them in its image, a vicious circle spiraling out of control.
For wisdom's sake, it was built high to gaze on all things. For glory's sake, it was built high as a testament of power. For strength's sake, it was built high to repel all attacks.
Both forge and pyre.
Centuries ago, Shizo was a verdant field of wildflowers. After 891 samurai died in a single battle on its grasses, it became a haunted moor.
The continent of Guul Draz is a geothermal swampland reeking of heat and decay.
On the continent of Tazeem, rushing waters plunge through narrow canyons into mist-cloaked lakes.
Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.
